title: Health checks: liveness, readiness, and the probe that lies

videos.script: Every service in the shop has a health endpoint, and every one of them answers ok. Even when the database is gone and no customer can buy anything. {{lies}} A health check is a question somebody else asks your service. A load balancer, Docker, Kubernetes, a probe on the other side of the world. And what they do with the answer is different every time. {{questions}} This lesson writes a check that tells the truth. Then it watches Docker mark a container unhealthy, and do nothing about it. {{docker}} On Kubernetes, one failed probe takes a pod out of traffic, and another restarts it. {{kube}} And one wrong probe restarts every copy of a service at once, because a database somewhere else went away. {{kills}} Last, the only check that asks what a customer would ask. A real checkout, from outside. {{outside}}
